description: kneecap forked opencut-classic, which was archived 2026-05-16 — no upstream will ever send us a security or dependency patch again (plan risk register #6). This repo owns its dependency tree permanently, so Renovate runs unusually eagerly here rather than at a typical app's cadence.

packageRules.description: Security/vulnerability fixes always go out immediately, any day, regardless of the weekly schedule above.

next / react / react-dom are the framework floor this whole app sits on (Next.js 16, React 19 per the inherited engine) — never auto-merge a major bump here without a manual look at the M2 engine-decoupling and M3 shell-scaffold assumptions.

opencut-wasm is the published artifact of THIS repo's own rust/wasm crate (see README's "Local WASM development") — Renovate bumping its npm version independently of a matching rust/ source change would desync the two. Flag, don't auto-bump.

mediabunny and @huggingface/transformers are the two dependencies with the most direct bearing on the zero-cost/offline directive (media I/O and the on-device-but-not-yet-fully-offline transcription worker — see docs/DECISIONS.md's known exceptions). Keep them visible and reviewed, not silently auto-merged.

Everything else: patch/minor updates that pass CI (scripts/invariants.sh, run on every PR per .github/workflows/bun-ci.yml) can auto-merge — low-risk, and this is exactly the kind of routine upkeep a dead upstream will never do for us again.
Group the Rust/Cargo ecosystem separately from npm — different release cadence and blast radius (the wgpu/wasm compositor chain is load-bearing for the whole preview pipeline, plan §2.1).
GitHub Actions pins (setup-bun, wasm-pack-action, cache, checkout) — low risk, keep current.
